skill.name: mmx-cli
skill.description: Generate text, images, video, speech, music, vision analysis, and web search through the MiniMax mmx CLI.
skill.summary: Run MiniMax multimodal generation workflows from agent-friendly terminal commands.
skill.author: MiniMax-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives from Markdown code spans, fenced bash examples, and documented mmx CLI flags. Confirmed risk remains around MiniMax credential persistence, command-line API key exposure, global npm installation, and third-party data transfer. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: API keys are shown in command-line arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer secure credential storage and warn users that command-line secrets may appear in shell history, process listings, logs, or transcripts.

remediation.issue: Authentication is persisted to a hidden credentials file.
remediation.suggestion: Document credential file permissions, logout or deletion steps, rotation guidance, and when user confirmation is required before writing credentials.

remediation.issue: The guide installs a global npm CLI package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed mmx-cli version, document the package source, and recommend isolated environments for agent use.

remediation.issue: Commands may send user data and local files to MiniMax APIs.
remediation.suggestion: Add consent guidance before uploading files, prompts, URLs, lyrics, webhook data, or other private content to external services.

| `--instrumental` | boolean | Generate instrumental music (no vocals). Cannot be used with `--lyric

semantic_findings.title: Global npm CLI Installation Risk
semantic_findings.description: The guide instructs users to install mmx-cli globally with npm. A community skill that installs and runs a global CLI package adds supply-chain and local execution risk unless the package version and source are verified.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Line 14 explicitly shows npm install -g mmx-cli, which changes the user environment and installs executable code from the package registry.

semantic_findings.title: API Key Exposure Through Command-Line Arguments
semantic_findings.description: The guide shows API keys passed through --api-key for login and per-call use. Real secrets in command arguments can be exposed through shell history, process listings, terminal logs, or shared transcripts.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 17 and 20 demonstrate --api-key usage with an sk-style placeholder, which maps directly to a common credential leakage path when replaced with a real key.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party Data Transfer and Upload Risk
semantic_findings.description: The documented workflows send prompts, text files, images, URLs, lyrics, and generated task data to MiniMax services. Agents should get explicit approval before sending private or regulated content.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines describe message files, tool definitions, text files, streaming audio, and image inputs that may contain private user data sent through mmx commands.

content.value_statement: Multimodal content creation often requires separate tools for text, images, video, speech, music, and search. This skill guides agents through mmx CLI commands for MiniMax workflows.
actual_capabilities: Generate chat completions with MiniMax text models using message and system prompt flags.
Generate images and return result URLs or saved file paths.
Start, poll, and download MiniMax video generation tasks.
Synthesize speech or music and write audio files or stream output.
Describe local images, image URLs, or MiniMax file IDs with vision prompts.
Run MiniMax web search and export command schemas for agent tools.
limitations: Requires the mmx CLI package and a valid MiniMax API key.
Sends prompts, uploaded media, and task data to MiniMax services.
Generation speed and downloads depend on API quotas, region, and model availability.
Provides command guidance only; it does not include the mmx CLI implementation.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Media
use_cases.description: Create images, short videos, narration, and background music from approved creative prompts.

use_cases.title: Automate Agent Workflows
use_cases.description: Use JSON output, non-interactive flags, and exported schemas to connect MiniMax commands to agent pipelines.

use_cases.title: Analyze and Search Visual Context
use_cases.description: Describe images, query MiniMax search, and combine results with generated content tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Generate an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mmx-cli to generate one 16:9 image from this prompt: [prompt]. Return the saved path or result URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Create Narration Audio
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mmx-cli to synthesize this script with voice [voice]. Save an MP3 file and report the output path: [script].

prompt_templates.title: Build an Async Video Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Start an async video generation task for [scene], poll the status, and download the final video to [path]. Use quiet JSON output.

prompt_templates.title: Register MiniMax Agent Tools
prompt_templates.prompt: Export the mmx schema for [command or all commands], inspect required arguments, and propose a safe agent tool plan.

output_examples.input: Generate a 16:9 hero image of a clean robotics lab.
output_examples.output: The skill returns MiniMax image result URLs or saved file paths, depending on the requested output mode.

output_examples.input: Create a short ocean waves video and save it locally.
output_examples.output: The workflow starts a video task, checks completion status, and saves the completed video file path.

output_examples.input: Turn a product announcement into narrated audio.
output_examples.output: The skill produces an MP3 file path and can include subtitle timing information when requested.

best_practices: Use non-interactive, quiet, and JSON output flags for agent and CI runs.
Get user approval before uploading local files, private prompts, or generated media.
Avoid command-line API keys in shared environments; use secure credential storage instead.
anti_patterns: Passing real API keys in chat prompts, shell history, or shared logs.
Uploading confidential images, documents, scripts, or lyrics without explicit approval.
Installing or updating global CLI packages in production agents without review.

faq.question: What does this skill help automate?
faq.answer: It guides agents through mmx commands for MiniMax text, image, video, speech, music, vision, search, quota, and schema workflows.

faq.question: Does it require a MiniMax account?
faq.answer: Yes. The mmx CLI needs a valid MiniMax API key and available quota for most commands.

faq.question: Can it save generated media files?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented commands include output paths for images, videos, speech audio, and music audio.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it send data to a third-party service?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts, files, URLs, and task data may be sent to MiniMax APIs when commands run.

faq.question: What should users review before using it?
faq.answer: Users should review API key handling, npm package trust, uploaded file sensitivity, and MiniMax account quota limits.
